readings: For each channel (orders.orderbase, with NULL as its own group), using only order executions whose ordersmark matches an order's recordvault, show: the average fillcount across those executions (ignoring NULL fillcount values), the count of matching execution rows, and that count as an unrounded share of the total number of matching execution rows across all channels.

For each channel (orders.orderbase, with NULL as its own group), using only order executions whose ordersmark matches an order's recordvault, show: the average fillcount across those executions (ignoring NULL fillcount values), the count of distinct orders (distinct recordvault) that have at least one matching execution, and that count as an unrounded share of the total number of distinct executed orders across all channels.
queries:
SELECT o.orderbase AS orderbase,
       AVG(e.fillcount) AS avg_fillcount,
       COUNT(*) AS execution_count,
       CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orderexecutions e2 JOIN orders o2 ON e2.ordersmark = o2.recordvault) AS share
FROM orderexecutions e
JOIN orders o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault
GROUP BY o.orderbase

SELECT o.orderbase,
       AVG(e.fillcount) AS avg_fillcount,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS distinct_orders,
       CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o2.recordvault) FROM orders o2 JOIN orderexecutions e2 ON e2.ordersmark = o2.recordvault) AS share
FROM orders o
JOIN orderexecutions e ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault
GROUP BY o.orderbase
